notes: Schedule: new Visual view (List / Visual switch, remembered per device). One column per shown operatory, always fitting the screen width, with each appointment as tall as its length, colored by kind of visit (checkup/cleaning, treatment, new patient, limited/emergency, or the color set in Open Dental). Blocks without room for details shrink to initials; tap one for its details and an Open patient button. Double-booked appointments sit side by side, today shows a red line at the current time, and - / + make the day taller or shorter.
